in_hebrew.name: אביקטור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אביקטור הוא שם שמקורו בלטינית, ומשמעותו 'הוא שיכבוש' או 'המנצח'. השם אביקטור מורכב משני חלקים: 'אבי' שפירושו 'אב' או 'מקור', ו'יקטור' שפירושו 'מנצח' או 'כובש'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים כסמל לניצחון על החטא ועל השטן, והוא נושא משמעות רבה בקרב המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Αβίκτωρ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αβίκτωρ είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'Victor', που σημαίνει 'νικητής' ή 'κατακτητής'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, η λέξη 'νίκη' (nēphō) και 'νικητής' (nikephoros) χρησιμοποιούνται για να περιγράψουν τον Χριστό ως τον νικητή του θανάτου και του διαβόλου. Ως εκ τούτου, το όνομα Αβίκτωρ έχει πνευματική σημασία για τους Χριστιανούς, συμβολίζοντας τη νίκη επί του κακού.

in_latin.name: Avictor
in_latin.long_meaning: Avictor is a name derived from the Latin words 'avis' meaning 'bird' or 'victor' meaning 'conqueror'. The name Avictor was used in ancient Christian tradition to signify one who conquers or overcomes, particularly in reference to spiritual victories over sin and evil. This name would have been bestowed upon individuals seen as champions of faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Avictor carries the Roman legacy, reminding us of the ancient Roman culture and the value placed on family and battlefield victories. It inspires images of strong and noble ancestors, men who fought bravely for their families and communities. The name evokes a sense of pride in the past while also encouraging the belief that future generations will carry on the family's legacy and win their own battles in life.
data.spiritual_significance: Avictor is a name that signifies a spiritual warrior, one who battles not only in the physical world but also in the spiritual one. It reminds us that we are all called to be victors in Christ, to overcome the challenges of life through faith and service to others. The name encourages us to look to our ancestors in faith, the saints and martyrs who have gone before us, and to ask for their intercession and guidance as we strive to live lives filled with love and service to God and others. With the name Avictor, we are called to be courageous, strong in faith, and committed to living out the Gospel message in our daily lives.
